summary.heading: Summary
summary.text: Over 5 years of experience. Specialized in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Building scalable web applications for international clients with thousands of active users.

bullets: Built an 8-step finder tool with localStorage persistence and dynamic step logic in React and TypeScript.
Developed typed Axios services for CMS integration with error handling, retry logic, and fallback data.
Implemented responsive layouts for 10+ structurally different page types — from complex comparison tables to multi-step wizards and blog articles.
Reduced frontend bugs through strict TypeScript typing and active participation in code reviews within an agile team.
Built filterable, paginated product listings for 35+ software categories with dynamic data display.
Developed UI components and landing pages for 10+ enterprise clients using HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery.
Implemented responsive, cross-browser-compatible layouts (IE8/9, Chrome, Firefox) with a mobile-first approach.
Optimized performance through CSS minification and JS cleanup — reduced page size by 20–25%.
Independently delivered landing page features within sprint cycles.

list.title: Sports Apparel Store
list.description: Headless e-commerce storefront powered by the Shopify Storefront GraphQL API, with server-rendered product pages and a full cart flow — Shopify owns the commerce data, Next.js owns the entire UI layer.

list.title: MovieTrailer
list.description: Movie & TV explorer with search, universal detail pages for both movies and shows, trailer playback, streaming provider info, and a personal watchlist — authenticated via Clerk.

list.title: Lingo CRM
list.description: CRM dashboard for freelance English tutors — student roster with search and CEFR-level filtering, a drag-and-drop weekly schedule (dnd-kit), and per-student pages tracking progress, attendance, and payment status. Localized in German and English.

list.title: Italian Kitchen
list.description: Recipe management platform with authenticated personal recipe books and saved collections, built on Server Actions and Zustand for client state.
